verdict.rationale: Kintsugi ships a documented REST API with authentication, official SDKs in five languages generated from an OpenAPI spec, and extensive per-endpoint reference docs (tax estimate, nexus, registrations, filings, exemptions, transactions), plus an llms.txt for AI discoverability. Missing for 10: a publicly resolvable OpenAPI/swagger file at the probed standard paths (404s), so machine-readable spec access isn't independently confirmed.
